articles.title: HEALTHCARE ALERT: Sasaram Hospital Plunged Into Darkness, Doctors Forced to Treat Patients Using Phone Torches
articles.description: A major healthcare lapse was reported at Sasaram’s Sadar Hospital in Bihar’s Rohtas district, where a power outage in the emergency ward forced doctors to treat patients using mobile phone flashlights. The sudden blackout caused panic and created difficulties for patients and their families, particularly those requiring urgent medical attention. The incident is especially concerning because the hospital reportedly has a dedicated transformer and a large generator as backup power arrangements. Despite these facilities, the emergency department was left without electricity, raising serious questions about hospital management and preparedness. When questioned about the incident, hospital authorities reportedly failed to provide a clear explanation, saying that efforts were being made to restore the electricity. The episode has sparked concerns over patient safety, infrastructure, and negligence in Bihar’s healthcare system.

Their ongoing agitation concerns alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations, which has entered its fifteenth day. Students are demanding cancellation of the 14th JPSC examination and an independent probe. Health concerns are intensifying among protesters, with some admitted to hospital for their hunger strike. The government states it is willing to engage and consider the students' demands sympathetically.

articles.title: Two Cities, Two Fires: Car Fire in Kolkata, Restaurant Gutted in Gorakhpur
articles.description: A fire broke out in a moving car near Vikas Bhavan in Salt Lake, Kolkata, creating panic as flames and smoke engulfed the vehicle. The occupants managed to get out safely, and firefighters quickly brought the blaze under control. A short circuit is suspected to have caused the fire, and no casualties were reported. Meanwhile, Gorakhpur’s famous Chatori Gali witnessed another fire incident at around 9 PM when a restaurant on the first floor caught fire, reportedly due to a short circuit. Customers and nearby visitors rushed to safety as flames spread. Two fire engines reached the spot and controlled the blaze in around 20 minutes. Although no one was injured, the restaurant’s belongings were completely destroyed, while two neighbouring shops also suffered damage.
